sentences.en: I get goose bumps when I see a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 看到恐怖电影时，我会起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: I couldn't bring myself to see the horror movie again.
sentences.zh: 我实在无法再次观看那部恐怖电影。

sentences.en: She turned away in horror at the sight of blood.
sentences.zh: 她看见血后吓得转开了头。

senses.zh: 恐怖的，令人毛骨悚然的
